info.name: AppConnect V3 Account Services Contact Lists API

params.name: list_id
params.description: The system generated ID that uniquely identifies a contact list.

params.name: include_membership_count
params.description: Returns the total number of contacts per list that meet your selection criteria. Set the `include_membership_count` to `active`, to count only active contacts, or `all` to include all contacts in the count.

items.docs: Use this method to get details about a specific contact list (`list_id`).

params.name: list_id
params.description: Unique ID of the contact list to update

items.docs: Updates an existing contact list resource, specified by `list_id`

params.name: list_id
params.description: Unique ID of the list to delete

items.docs: Deletes the specified contact list and its membership. DELETE List requests are processed asynchronously, and you can track the status of the request by making a GET call to the URI shown in the `_links` property in the response.

params.name: limit
params.description: Use to specify the number of results displayed per page of output, from 1 - 500, default = 50.

params.name: include_count
params.description: Set `include_count` to `true` to return the total number of contact lists that meet your selection criteria.

params.name: include_membership_count
params.description: Use to include the total number of contacts per list. Set to  `active`, to count only active (mailable) contacts, or `all` to count all contacts.

params.name: name
params.description: Use to get details for a single list by entering the full name of the list.

params.name: status
params.description: Use to get lists by status. Accepts comma-separated status values.

params.name: channel_type
params.description: Use to return lists by channel type. The default value is `email`.

params.name: include_sms_membership_count
params.description: Set to `true` to return the total number of SMS members in each list. Only applicable when `channel_type` is `sms`. Default is `false`.

info.name: GET a collection of V2 and V3 API List IDs

params.name: sequence_ids
params.description: Comma delimited list of V2 API list `ids` to cross-reference with the V3 API `list_id` value. Endpoint accepts a maximum of 500 ids at a time.

items.docs:
Use this endpoint to migrate your locally stored V2 contact list data to the new V3 format. Developers are expected to use this endpoint sparingly. This endpoint is NOT intended for regular or repeated use. Constant Contact will eventually deprecate and remove this endpoint.
